text_block_list.text:
Even after winning the Bamboo Stakes, we 
kept claiming victory hand-in-hand with 
Sasami Anshinzawa―― and the day of the 
decisive battle, the Sasabari Cup, finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
This day has finally come! Looking back, 
so much has happened~.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Fan Thanksgiving, summer camp, 
Valentine's, Christmas―― So many fun 
things, all sorts of 'em♪
choice_data_list:
Was it there...? Wait, now I feel like it 
was?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Looks like your head's in the clouds right 
before the big stage~? Jeez, there's no 
need to be so nervous!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're my partner, aren't you?! A hard 
worker who hung out with me while working 
as a Trainer, and even did personal 
training on top of that!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course I knew that! I saw it with my 
own eyes!! I'm your fan, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I believe you're the only one who can 
claim victory in the Sasabariwinkle 
Series――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove it to you with these fine 
bamboo needles...!
choice_data_list: Safe and sound is the top priority...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Leave it all to me~☆ Here we go~!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here goes! Right into the sweet spot!!
Bullseye needle poke, massive success!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
See, see, seeee! Didn't fail, did I? When 
I'm on the job, it's pretty much a piece 
of cake☆

Enveloped in a sense of total relief, as 
if cradled by the embrace of Mother Ocean, 
I was able to head toward the stage of our 
decisive battle.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! Ah, no, just seeing things, 
just seeing things! Came out looking 
pretty good, right?
choice_data_list:
No good…… I can't feel re-aaassured at 
all……!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Y-You'll be fine! You can totally do this! 
You've worked so hard to get here, right? 
Come on!

Win or lose, today's race decides who 
stands at the pinnacle. In that case... 
all I can do is give it everything I've 
got.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I know, I know☆ Here I go~!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here goes! Right into the sweet spot!!
Bullseye needle poke, massive success!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yahooo~~☆ Glowing skin and totally fired 
up! Now that's what I call a massive 
success~♪
choice_data_list:
Incredible! I don't feel like I could lose 
to anyone!

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the sasabari treatment, I was 
able to head to the showdown in absolute 
peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Uh-ohhh~? Your reaction's a little slow, 
isn't it??
choice_data_list: I don't feel like much has changed.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That can't be true~! The needle placement 
was just a teeeeny bit off, totally within 
margin of error☆

Questions linger, but whether we laugh or 
cry, today's race decides who stands at 
the pinnacle. In that case... all we can 
do is give it everything we've got.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, looking good~! Now that's 
the re~assuring running style I love to 
see!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa☆ Incredible acceleration!! Could it 
be... or rather, is it definitely...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ So, Isami-chan, what do you think of 
my proud partner?!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on☆ Call me Beauty Anshinzawa, 
Big Sis! ...Though, I suppose you're 
right――

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: He is absolutely, truly beauty-ful♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: She is absolutely, truly beauty-ful♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...It's going to be okay. I know for 
certain that your trainer will win.

And as a vast crowd watched on, the winner 
of the turbulent "Acupuncture Cup" was――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Sniff... That's my partner for you! An 
undisputed first-place finish, waaaahhh~!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, oh yes! With this, both our names 
will be etched forever into the history of 
acupuncture—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, none of that matters right now! <username>, 
congratulations on the wiiiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let me offer my heartfelt congratulations 
as well. <chrname> is overjoyed too♪

If how I looked today had a good influence 
on <chrname>, then—

That is a safe, reliiieving, and truly 
happy thing.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: By the way—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Why has it come to this?

The question Ms. Tazuna blurted out was, 
frankly, entirely reasonable.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Her running is awfully inconsistent... 
None of her usual steady reliability.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa☆ Could this be... or rather, is it 
definitely...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! We got passed...! Oh no, what if it's 
because my Sasabari failed?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
How unexpected... For you to blame 
yourself, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
S-Savage~! Wait, did you actually think 
I'd blame them? I'd never do that!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Even so, as a Trainer, I've watched over 
her by her side all this time――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I know better than anyone just how hard 
he's worked for this!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I know better than anyone just how hard 
she's worked for this!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps I had the wrong impression of 
you.

And as a vast crowd watched on, the winner 
of the turbulent "Acupuncture Cup" was――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! Don't look so down in the dumps! You 
did great, you know☆
choice_data_list: Still... I really wanted to win.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Blocked by the other runners, breaking out 
was difficult, wasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, if we build up your power and 
strength, you definitely won't lose next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Even though the 
"Sasaballinkle Series" has come to an end—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I still wanna keep running alongside you 
so much more, you know! ♪ Come on, isn't 
that great?

Though the goal wasn't reached, the days 
spent with Sasami Anshinzawa were by no 
means wasted.

Accumulated experience connects straight 
to the future. Yes――to a safe, sound, and 
glorious future.
